title: Operator identity can file AI proposals (S)
description: An IAM operator role of the site's own account can file AI proposals (fileProposal) and move a draft to in_steering or declined (transitionProposal), recorded as operator:<ARN> in the history. IAM can never approve, review-decide or override; identity-pool users and other accounts are refused. CLI (papyrus proposals create|transition|publish with PAPYRUS_GRAPHQL_AUTH=iam) and the idea pipeline --store proposals use it. Unblocks PPY-8ffc18, scheduled automations and Shipped's first proposal. Docs: reader-steering.md Operator filing, idea-pipeline.md.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Shipped in PR #670 (merge b66fcda0980dbf1ec2ee0b51e6404016840244c9) into develop; board PR #669 (merge b67f44c8e3851209e1c60a88c88417a81eb21d5b). CI green (python, ts, smoke). Not promoted to main. Sites need a backend deploy of the reader-actions function; operator IAM policy needs appsync:GraphQL on Mutation/fields/fileProposal and transitionProposal.
